evidence_for_evaluation: Evaluates multi-frame generation fidelity and action controllability with PSNR, SSIM, FVD, and action perturbations.
publication_lineage: Distinct Surgical Vision World Model study; no duplicate record identified.
rationale: The learned action-conditioned surgical dynamics model is directly evaluated.

title: Surgical Procedural Planning as 3D World Modelling: Towards Automated Pulmonary Resection
evidence_for_dynamics: Uses an action-conditioned 3D diffusion model as an anatomical consequence module inside procedural planning.
evidence_for_evaluation: Evaluates clinical planning and ablates the simulator, with marked losses in step, critical-step, overlap, and semantic metrics.
publication_lineage: Official CVPR 2026 workshop paper; distinct from other surgical world-model records.
rationale: The learned action-response model is empirically evaluated through its contribution to internal surgical planning.
